title: Calf Self-Massage
summary: The hands lightly stroke the calf upward without deep pressure.
goal: Gently relax the calf muscles after walking.
startingPosition: Sit with the leg fully supported.
instructions: Place the hands on the calf above the Achilles tendon.
Do not press the tendon or behind the knee.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
